title: Natural Earth 1:50m lakes
licenseVerification: Primary Natural Earth terms were inspected during original boundary asset preparation; same dataset provider and pinned repository.
processing: Selected features whose bounding boxes intersect longitude -170 to -20 and latitude 7 to 85; retained lake names and feature class; coordinates rounded to four decimals. No additional simplification.
limits: Generalized cartographic lake-water polygons for a visual overlay, not navigable shorelines or legal water boundaries.
Large administrative polygons can include lake water; draw lake fill above land with pointer-events:none, so water appears while state/province selection remains accessible.
Overlay supplies freshwater shore context only; it does not establish Indigenous territories.
